sample_inputs.label: HIGH RISK — Contractor Agreement
sample_inputs.text: The contractor shall indemnify and hold harmless the Company from any and all claims. The Company may terminate this agreement immediately and without cause at its sole discretion. All intellectual property created shall be considered work for hire. The contractor waives any right to arbitration or class action proceedings.

sample_inputs.label: MEDIUM RISK — Vendor NDA
sample_inputs.text: Either party may terminate this agreement with a 30-day notice period. The vendor shall keep all client data confidential and shall not disclose any proprietary information to third parties without prior written consent. Disputes shall be resolved by arbitration under the governing law of Delaware.

sample_inputs.label: LOW RISK — Payment Terms
sample_inputs.text: The Company shall pay the contractor a monthly retainer of $5,000 on the first business day of each month. All payments shall be made via bank transfer. Both parties agree to communicate in good faith regarding any disagreements.
